# Video index (generated by make_videos.py)

Playback: 1 frame per control at 30 fps = 3x real time (the simulator runs 10 controls per second); world-model clips run at half that speed. Clips are examples from validation scenes (seeds 400000 and 400020), which were also used to pick checkpoints; success rates come from the fresh-scene tests in ../data. Legend: ../images/video_legend.png.
